zh: (1879-1955) a physicist, born in Germany, who was possibly the greatest scientist of the 20th century. In 1905 he published his theory of relativity. Einstein suggested how it could be used for making weapons, but after the Second World War he spoke publicly against nuclear weapons. By 1917, he had become famous all over the world. He was given the Nobel Prize for physics in 1921. When Hitler came to power, Einstein, who was Jewish, went to live in the US, becoming a US citizen in 1940. In 1933 he wrote a book called Why War?with Sigmund Freud. He became a professor at Princeton University in 1934, and he spent the rest of his life looking, without success, for a theory that combined those of gravitation and electromagnetism. a person who studied alchemy
ex: It was believed that the successful alchemist had to be attuned to nature’s powers.
人们认为，成功的炼金术士必须适应自然的力量。

zh: 炼金术（见于中世纪，企图把普通金属炼成黄金）
en: a form of chemistry studied in the Middle Ages that involved trying to discover how to change ordinary metals into gold

zh: （澳大利亚土著神话中的）世界发端，梦想期，梦幻时代
en: according to some Australian Aboriginals, the time when the first people were created
drinks such as beer, wine, etc. that can make people drunk
ex: He never drinks alcohol.
他从来不喝酒。

zh: 酒精中毒者；嗜酒如命者；酒鬼
en: connected with or containing alcohol
ex: alcoholic drinks/beverages
含酒精的饮料

zh: 匿名戒酒会（1935 年成立于芝加哥的国际组织，成员不用全名）
en: an international organization, begun in Chicago in 1935, for people who are trying to stop drinking alcohol. They have meetings to help each other.
ex: self-help groups like Alcoholics Anonymous
自助团体，如戒酒者匿名

en: the medical condition caused by drinking too much alcohol regularly
ex: Three people in the family suffer from alcoholism.
这家有 3 人酒精中毒。

en: a sweet fizzy (= with bubbles) drink that contains alcohol

zh: 壁凹，凹室，壁龛（房内墙壁凹进空间）
en: an area in a room that is formed by part of a wall being built further back than the rest of the wall
ex: The bookcase fits neatly into the alcove.
书架正好放得进壁凹。

zh: 桤木（多见于北方国家潮湿地区）
en: a tree of the birch family that grows in northern countries, usually in wet ground

zh: （旧时英格兰和威尔士的）高级市政官（职位低于市长）
（美国、加拿大、澳大利亚的）市政委员会委员
en: (in England and Wales in the past) a senior member of a town, borough or county council, below the rank of a mayor, chosen by other members of the council
ex: Alderman Tim Evans
市政委员会委员蒂姆 · 埃文斯

zh: a town in Hampshire, England, which is one of the main centres for the army. People think of it as an army town.
en: a town in Hampshire, England, which is one of the main centres for the army. People think of it as an army town.

zh: 一杯（或一瓶、一罐）麦芽啤酒
en: a type of beer without bubbles. There are several kinds of ale.
ex: He drank several pints of ale.
他喝了几品脱麦芽酒。

zh: relating to music or other forms of art that involve elements of chance in their creation or performance
en: relating to music or other forms of art that involve elements of chance in their creation or performance
ex: Some will be amused to know that Mozart composed aleatory music and even devised a dice game to write it.
有些人会很高兴地知道，莫扎特创作了偶然的音乐，甚至设计了一个骰子游戏来编写它。
